design_philosophy.vision: Transform the skeleton into an energetic, polished, responsive, end-to-end local arcade game with zero mandatory login, immediate playable gratification, persistence, local rankings, combo mechanics, and tactile feedback.
core_principles: Immediate Playability: Zero friction, instant start screen into action with single tap/key press.
Vibrant Arcade Aesthetics: High-contrast dark void background with glowing neon cyan, hot magenta, electric yellow, and CRT scanline CRT overlays.
Juicy Feedback & Polish: Screen shake, particle explosions, dynamic combo multipliers, floating point indicators, audio visualizers, and state transitions.
Persistence & Progression: Browser localStorage sync + backend leaderboard persistence, unlocking skins, tracking personal high scores, and achievement badges.

component_structure.navigation: HeaderNav with Volume Toggle, Theme Skin Selector, High Score Badge, Local Leaderboard Modal Trigger, Reset Progress Trigger
screens: AttractScreen / Start Screen (Title, High Score, Select Difficulty, Select Skin, Press Start / Tap to Play CTA)
GameplayScreen (HUD canvas/grid, Combo counter, Score multiplier, Power-ups, Lives/Timer, Virtual Touch D-Pad / Controls for Mobile)
PauseOverlay (Resume, Restart, Audio toggles, Keybindings guide)
GameOverScreen (Final Score, New Record indicator, Combo breakdown, Restart Button, Save Name to Local Leaderboard)
VictoryScreen (Clear Time, Accuracy bonus, Celebratory confetti particle explosion, Next Level/Infinite Mode)
widgets: LocalLeaderboardModal (Tabs: All-time, Today, Difficulty levels, Clear Scores button)
AchievementsDrawer (Unlocked badges, combo streaks, games played)
AudioVisualizer (Toggle SFX / Arcade synth BGM simulation with volume slider)
ControlsGuide (Keyboard arrows/WASD/Space + Mobile Touch Joystick diagram)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, standalone, end-to-end playable arcade game inside src/pages/Home.tsx (or subcomponents in src/components/game/).

Preserve zero-login local functionality using localStorage for high scores, game history, unlocked themes, and stats, with smooth REST API synchronization to backend/server.py (/api/scores, /api/leaderboard, /api/status).
Include responsive desktop keyboard controls (WASD/Arrows + Space) and mobile-friendly touch d-pad/action buttons so it is 100% playable on all devices.
Add audio effects using Web Audio API synthesis (synth beeps, coin sounds, explosion sounds) with mute/volume controls so no external audio files are required.
Provide crisp victory, game over, pause overlays, level difficulty controls, skin customization, local leaderboard, and combo multipliers.
Ensure every single interactive element has explicit data-testid attributes matching data_testid_guidelines.

anti_patterns: Do NOT leave placeholder text or incomplete screens.
Do NOT require external user authentication to start or save high scores.
Do NOT use transparent dropdown backgrounds without heavy backdrop blurs.
Do NOT default to standard centered white layout; maintain the high-contrast neon arcade vibe.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_compliance: Ensure all buttons, inputs, modals, and score text fields feature stable data-testid attributes for automated testing.
